Important: This is a pre-owned product and is not in brand-new cosmetic condition. Scratches, scuffs and other reasonable signs of previous use may be present and will vary between individual units. Product images are for model reference only. Cosmetic imperfections do not affect the intended functionality of the product.

Grade A – Approx. 90% New
Excellent overall condition. May have minor scratches, marks or light signs of previous use.

Grade B – Approx. 80% New
Good functional condition with more visible scratches, scuffs or signs of previous use.

Every Pre-Owned HITWAY is inspected for:

Motor operation

Battery and charging

Display and controls

Braking system

Lights and electrical functions

Tyres and wheels

Basic riding functionality

Powerful Drive with Boost Motor:

Experience effortless and efficient riding with the HITWAY BK36. The integrated 20-inch hub motor with a 250W motor provides powerful assistance and a top speed of 25 km/h – perfect for both city commutes and rural roads.

Long-Lasting Battery Performance:

Equipped with a high-quality 48V 10.4Ah lithium-ion battery, the BK36 offers an impressive range of 50 to 100 km per charge – depending on load, temperature, and riding conditions. With a short charging time of just 5-6 hours, you’re always ready for your next adventure.

Durable and Portable Construction:

The frame, made of aluminum alloy, combines durability, corrosion resistance, and excellent shock absorption. The foldable design and removable battery make transport and storage easy. Despite its solid total weight of 31.6 kg, the BK36 remains easy to handle and is perfect for everyday use.

High-Performance 20-Inch Fat Tires:

The e-bike is equipped with robust 20 x 4.0-inch tires that provide superior traction and stability on a variety of surfaces. Whether on asphalt, sand, or snow, the wide tires ensure a comfortable ride in all conditions.

Safety and Comfort Features:

The multifunctional LCD display, powerful front light, and reflective elements ensure safety and visibility. The reliable disc brakes on both the front and rear wheels guarantee precise braking, while the comfortable tires provide a smooth and stable ride.
